subject.title: fix(plugins): keep run context available after registration

question: Should the existing `api.runContext` methods be a supported long-lived runtime handle after synchronous plugin registration completes?
rationale: The documented API purpose and current facade design support the change, but extending the callable lifetime of an external plugin API establishes a compatibility contract that should be intentional.

options.title: Confirm Runtime Lifetime
options.body: Confirm the API is intentionally retained for runtime callbacks and merge after the contributor supplies real installed-plugin proof.

options.title: Use Separate Runtime Handle
options.body: Keep registration APIs synchronous-only and expose run context through a separately injected runtime callback handle.

recommendation.title: Confirm Runtime Lifetime
recommendation.body: Confirm the API is intentionally retained for runtime callbacks and merge after the contributor supplies real installed-plugin proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline specifically routes this lifecycle discussion to them, and they are the strongest available candidate to confirm the plugin API contract.
